text: This supersedes 3ecb53871518f37b57de61255854cd9feb26056510ec9c8dfda47596574ae0d1. The earlier conditional multi-commit mismatch used the wrong reader implementation and is withdrawn. Both owned and accepted migration tests import RepoClient from fluent.migrate.repo_client. The producing tool imports the separate comm fluent.migratetb client; that fork log method cannot establish the test reader order. The owned change removes reversed(messages), and accepted validation follows returned order. The upstream reader requires separate scoped evidence; the privately checked unpaired helper is not public comm or historical paired proof. No migration run, universal ordering guarantee or new audit credit is claimed.
title: Migration validation and its producer use different RepoClient imports
